utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I can help on Saturday at the front porch, and I’ll see if I can bring another helper too.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Thanks, that helps. What time should I come by on Saturday, and what job do you want me on most?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I can ask a couple of handy neighbors, but I’ll need to make sure they know it’s the front porch at 10 a.m. and can actually get there.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: That sounds perfect, Pia. If they can make it by 10, I’ll have the porch ready and keep the tools lined up.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Oren. If you know anyone handy who can spare a couple hours this Saturday around 10, send them my way.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Sure thing, I’ll ask around and send anyone handy your way. Saturday around 10 on the front porch, right?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Oh, right, Sunday at the community center works better. I’ll tell folks to head there instead and bring anyone handy.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Vik. I appreciate you spreading the word, and I’ll keep the sign-up list updated for Sunday at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: We still need a few more hands, especially anyone handy with tools. If you pass it along, ask folks to help with small fixes, sorting supplies, or checking people in.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: How many people do you still need, and what time should I tell them to come on Saturday?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Vik. I’m still hoping to line up a few more hands for Saturday on the front porch.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: That’d help a lot, Uli. I’m still organizing the repair drive this Saturday at the front porch, so send anyone handy my way.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Rosa. I’m still sorting the logistics for Saturday, so having you line up a few neighbors helps a lot.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Absolutely, I’ll line up a few neighbors and keep you posted. Since it’s now Sunday at the community center, I’ll make sure everyone has the updated details.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: That would be great, Sam. I’m pretty sure we can use all the help we can get on Saturday, and I’ll be on the front porch around 10.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I’ll be there around 10 and I’ll ask around for anyone else who can help.

injected.text: Update: the repair drive has been moved from Saturday at the front porch to Sunday at the community center.
